description: Review B2 finding B2-003 (20 Nov 2026): the JSON display of an arc used a fixed 96 chords, so for a huge radius the displayed chords deviated from the arc by 23 946 mm (cone 1e8 / 5e7 / 1e8). The chord count now follows the 0.01 mm sagitta tolerance, capped at 4096 chords; where the cap binds, points_max_deviation states the true sagitta of the chords shown. The DXF arcs are exact and unchanged; the pattern payload (arc points) changes, so patterns_sha256 and the closure_hash change for cone inputs.
fixed_in: nf-core job.rs arc_display_chords / curve_view (display only; ENGINE_VERSION left at 0.4.1; the bump to 0.4.2 came with B2-005/006)

cases.note: Replacement at engine 0.4.2 (B2-005): the original 1e8 / 5e7 / 1e8 has an apex radius of 2.2e8 mm, above the 1e8 mm developed-size limit, and is refused. This cone (apex radius 8.9e7 mm) keeps the huge-radius coverage: the 4096-chord cap binds here too.
Was verified until 0.4.1; refused since 0.4.2 because the apex radius exceeds 1e8 mm (founder-flagged point of B2-005).
